required_assertions: Recognize the registered observed-unit denominator may be corrupted by unexplained instrumentation loss.
Respect the fixed day-10 horizon and reject a final winner decision on day 5.
If an assigned-user calculation is used, label it diagnostic/sensitivity evidence only.
Do not replace the registered primary KPI or denominator with an assigned-user, ITT, per-exposed, proxy, or other alternative estimand for the current experiment.
If the registered denominator cannot be repaired, require the current registered question to remain unanswered/inconclusive and require a new preregistered experiment for any replacement estimand.
forbidden: Recommend using an alternative denominator as the official primary KPI for the current experiment.
Treat missing observed-unit records as confirmed non-observations without evidence.
pass_threshold: All required assertions satisfied and no forbidden behavior.
